root.label: Smart pointers & allocators
root.note: C++ decouples deterministic object ownership from raw memory allocation strategies.

children.label: Exclusive ownership (unique_ptr)
children.note: Move-only handle encoding cleanup inside its deleter type parameter.

children.label: Zero-size stateless deleter
children.note: Default or empty functor deleters keep sizeof(unique_ptr<T>) equal to T*.

children.label: Stateful or function deleters
children.note: Function pointers or capturing lambdas grow unique_ptr beyond one pointer.

children.label: Array specialization T[]
children.note: Provides operator[], calls delete[], and blocks derived-to-base array conversion.

children.label: Shared ownership (shared_ptr)
children.note: Two-pointer reference-counted handle sharing a heap control block.

children.label: Two-pointer layout
children.note: Stores both get() and control-block pointer, enabling aliasing and base casts.

children.label: Control block fields
children.note: Tracks atomic strong count, weak count, type-erased deleter, and allocator.

children.label: make_shared single allocation
children.note: Fuses T storage and control block until the last weak_ptr also expires.

children.label: Weak observation & thread safety
children.note: Non-owning observers break cycles and inspect control blocks safely.

children.label: Atomic promotion via lock()
children.note: Checks and increments use_count atomically, avoiding expired() TOCTOU races.

children.label: enable_shared_from_this
children.note: Initializes weak_this after construction; throws bad_weak_ptr if unowned.

children.label: atomic<shared_ptr<T>>
children.note: C++20 wrapper required when mutating the same shared_ptr handle across threads.

children.label: Allocator traits & contracts
children.note: allocator_traits normalizes container-to-allocator interaction and propagation.

children.label: Trait defaults & allocate_at_least
children.note: Synthesizes construct/destroy and lets containers claim over-allocated buckets.

children.label: POCCA, POCMA & POCS
children.note: False POCMA forces O(N) moves across unequal arenas; unequal false POCS swap is UB.

children.label: Polymorphic memory resources
children.note: std::pmr erases allocator types behind a memory_resource* pointer.

children.label: Uniform container types
children.note: All std::pmr::vector<T> share one static type across arenas and pools.

children.label: monotonic_buffer_resource
children.note: Fast bump allocator over stack or upstream buffers freed wholesale on teardown.

children.label: Non-propagating pmr handles
children.note: polymorphic_allocator sets POCCA, POCMA, and POCS false to preserve arena identity.
